races.paceDynamic: Spartan Times, Iolaos Du Mou, and Auntie Maggie will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three having confirmed front-running tendencies. The sustained pace over 2m will test stamina reserves, particularly with 16 runners creating congestion and forcing horses wide. Little Soiree and Ten Ten Twenty may also contribute to the early pace from prominent positions, further ensuring no let-up. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can conserve energy and finish strongly, as the early pace will take its toll on those racing keenly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders maintain a genuine gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The relentless pace will set up perfectly for patient hold-up horses who can stay on strongly. Stamina becomes the key factor as front-runners tire approaching the final flight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Collapse Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes messy with leaders backing off
scenarios.body: Little Soiree or Ten Ten Twenty can capitalise from their prominent positions when the race becomes more tactical. The reduced early pace allows them to quicken more effectively late on.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leaders Dominate Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Auntie Maggie or Iolaos Du Mou get an easy lead
scenarios.body: One of the front-runners capitalises on a lack of early pressure to dictate terms completely. Their stamina proves superior when allowed to control the tempo throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Aid Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the large field causes significant interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Congestion plays havoc with the fancied runners' chances, allowing a horse with a clear run to capitalise. The pace still plays its part but lucky positioning becomes crucial.

watchPoints.text: Westerton faces major fitness test after 502 days off, likely to need this desperately despite talent
Spartan Times carries top weight after long break with poor recent form, stamina reserves questionable
Little Soiree and Ten Ten Twenty both have claiming riders taking valuable weight off in big field
Iolaos Du Mou and Auntie Maggie both returning from lengthy breaks but expected to set strong pace
Desert Halo has recent winner's penalty but proven form figures suggest he can overcome the extra weight

races.paceDynamic: Not At That Price will dictate terms from the front with no serious pace pressure in this small maiden field. Barry Fife and Noble Don may track prominently but neither has shown sustained early aggression. The moderate tempo will suit patient hold-up horses who can produce late kicks over this 2m trip. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up performers who can capitalise on the expected sprint finish when the pace lifts late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady until the final 3f as expected
scenarios.body: Not At That Price will weaken when the tempo increases, allowing closers with tactical speed to sweep past. Trigg and Lexington Wood are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Not At That Price faces minimal late pressure and stays strong
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace pressure allows the leader to control sectionals and kick clear when challenged. Barry Fife's prominent style could also benefit if tracking the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Barry Fife or Noble Don press Not At That Price early
scenarios.body: This creates a more genuine gallop that exposes the staying limitations of some hold-up horses. The tactical battle up front sets up a different finishing dynamic with mid-race positioning crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Not At That Price goes too slowly and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint with little pattern, potentially suiting any horse with instant acceleration. Form and class become secondary to who finds the clearest passage in a cavalry charge finish.

watchPoints.text: Not At That Price's early tempo setting - if too generous it plays into hold-up horses' hands completely
Trigg's jumping under pressure - any mistakes when asked to quicken could prove costly in tight finish
Barry Fife's positioning turning for home - needs to be close enough to challenge when pace lifts
Lexington Wood's fitness after 70-day break - any signs of blowing up in final furlong undermines strong profile
Weather conditions on the day - any overnight rain could alter going and compromise some horses' effectiveness

races.paceDynamic: Cruz Control will be the lone pacesetter in this 3m chase, setting a steady gallop without pressure from the front. The majority of the field - including prominent runners Bhaloo, Calimystic, Party Vibes and Miralago - will settle in behind him in the early stages. With no pace pressure and a strong contingent of hold-up horses like Capodanno, King's Threshold, Joyeux Machin and Horantzau d'Airy waiting at the back, this sets up as a tactical affair that will develop late. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the steady pace and kick when it counts, rather than the hold-up horses who may find insufficient pace to run at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace allows prominent runners to travel well and time their challenges
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure lets horses like Calimystic, Bhaloo and Party Vibes get into perfect rhythm before unleashing strong finishes. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground when the pace hasn't been strong enough to stretch the field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Cruz Control maintains his lead and the chasers leave it too late
scenarios.body: The steady early gallop plays perfectly into Cruz Control's hands as he builds an unassailable lead turning for home. Despite his modest recent form, the tactical scenario suits him perfectly against opponents who are too patient.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Times It
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly in the middle stages
scenarios.body: A stronger gallop in the second half allows the back markers like King's Threshold and Capodanno to use their finishing kicks effectively. The prominent runners get drawn into a faster pace than ideal and weaken late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Cruz Control goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: An overly sedate pace turns this into a dash from the last fence where fitness and recent form become crucial. Fresh horses with good acceleration like those returning from longer breaks could surprise.

watchPoints.text: Cruz Control's early pace will be crucial - if he goes too steady it kills the chances of all the hold-up horses behind
Bhaloo making his seasonal reappearance after 154 days could either run with freshness or need the run
The prominent runners Calimystic, Party Vibes and Miralago traveling well into the straight will signal the most likely outcome
King's Threshold and Capodanno need to be making ground from halfway or they'll have too much to do
First-time headgear changes on Bhaloo (cheekpieces) and tongue-ties on multiple runners suggest connections seeking improvement

races.paceDynamic: Butchers Bill will likely set the pace from the front with minimal early pressure, given his prominent style and lack of other confirmed front-runners in this field. The prominent runners Ultra Viers, Cher Monsieur, Jo Arengeot Bey and Tom Desjy will track just behind, but none appear aggressive enough to force a strong gallop early. This creates a scenario where the pace will be steady rather than searching, allowing the race to develop into a sprint finish over the final circuit. The lack of early pace pressure clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, particularly those with proven finishing ability like Choice Runner and Warner's Cross.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady as expected with Butchers Bill allowed an easy lead
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows closers to get into perfect position before unleashing late runs that the early leaders cannot match. Hold-up specialists with tactical speed benefit most from this patient tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Butchers Bill and the prominent group go too slow early and sprint finish lacks pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl where positioning matters more than pure finishing speed, suiting horses that can quicken from any position. Those with tactical versatility benefit from the lack of true pace throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Persist
scenarios.trigger: If Ultra Viers or Cher Monsieur apply more pressure than expected and maintain strong gallop
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and prevents the hold-up horses from getting into the race effectively. Forward-running horses with stamina reserves can hold off late challengers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Butchers Bill gets such an easy lead that he has plenty left for the finish
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure allows the leader to dictate completely and kick clear when the field comes to challenge. Those tracking closest have the best chance to respond.

watchPoints.text: Butchers Bill could get too easy a lead given the lack of early pace pressure and steal the race if allowed to dictate completely

Ultra Viers carrying just 145lbs could be very dangerous if the weights tell the story, particularly with his recent consistent form
New Invention and Tom Desjy both have warnings about fading in the finish so must be watched for market confidence
Warner's Cross has the best course form in the field with his previous win here and handles good going well

races.paceDynamic: Whatsupwithyou and Miss Maverick are confirmed front runners who will contest the early pace over this 2m4f trip. With two willing leaders, they'll create a genuine gallop from flag to finish, preventing any crawling sectionals that might suit pure hold-up horses. The honest pace will stretch the field and create gaps for prominent runners to exploit, while the extended distance means stamina becomes crucial in the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders duel and weaken each other in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will find out the front runners' stamina reserves, allowing horses tracking in third or fourth to strike with superior finishing speed. Sir Galahad and Liverpool Knight are perfectly positioned to benefit from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is more sedate than anticipated despite two leaders
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up brigade could pay dividends if they can navigate the crowded finish successfully. El Galactico and Last Kingdom have the class to sweep past tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an uncontested lead after the other falters early
scenarios.body: Miss Maverick's fresher legs after 287 days off could see her dominate if Whatsupwithyou doesn't fire. Her dual wins at this distance suggest she can sustain a strong gallop to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too hard and completely capitulate in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race could become a sprint finish between hold-up horses who conserved energy throughout. This unlikely scenario would suit the biggest closers with tactical speed.

watchPoints.text: Miss Maverick's return from 287 days could see her either dominate with freshness or show rust early
Liverpool Knight's fitness after 190-day absence will be crucial given his prominent racing style needs sustained effort
Whatsupwithyou and Miss Maverick's early battle will set the tempo and determine whether hold-up horses get into contention
El Galactico's hold-up style requires a strong pace to be effective, making the leaders' duel critical to his chances
Sir Galahad's ability to secure an ideal tracking position behind the leaders will determine his winning prospects

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.label: D

With Pony Soprano able to control fractions unchallenged, this sets up perfectly for the prominent racers who can position close enough to strike when the pace inevitably quickens approaching the business end. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can avoid getting caught behind the inevitable late traffic jam.

scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with established contenders hampered or unseated. Start Again or Jet Smart benefit from cleaner passages when others encounter trouble.
